title: 3 AI Agents Argue and Beat Any Single AI on Accuracy
description:
Comment "DEBATE" and we'll send you the setup guide.

We made three AI agents argue with each other, and the final answer came out more accurate than what any solo agent produced.

One AI answers. Second tears it apart. First defends and rewrites. A few rounds. Third AI plays judge. A 2026 study showed 4 to 6% accuracy boost and 30% fewer hallucinations.

The wild part, they change their mind mid-debate. No ego. Can't say the same about people on Twitter.

#aiagents #claudeai #aitools #aitok #multiagent
